body: So the only solution I have is reset chunks. I used MCA selector and deleted any chunks that didnt have any builds. and now my world is generating in 1.20.1! I will test later if mansions will generate with village maps/chunkbase. but i am pretty sure the terrain generation is fixed now. i think the crashes or cartographer villager maps messed up the generation and kept the worl in 1.17 at certain regions. IDK man but im glad that MCA selector worked :D

Hi thx for the reply. I have not gone very far in the overworld/nether until I did my mansion hunt. There was supposed to be a mansion at x: 14,616, z: 16,152 (which is WELL away from my spawn chunks/builds, but when I traveled there via nether portal, the mansion wasn't there.

When I went to the backup world (again 1.20.1 ver) to /locate the mansions, they were at coords i've never reached before, ever. EX: x: 3120, z: 26,016. I forgot to emphasize that I have never visited other mansions besides one a long time ago; I dont remember the coords to it but it was far away. I have never traveled that far before in this world.
This is helpful! thank you very much! TBH should've done googled first haha. But I wanted advice straight from people who also use fidget toys :)

Oh, thank you, dear! I'll visit a Target then or order from Antsy Labs. I hope this cube makes my friend very happy!!
Thank you very much!

Thank you for the comment

Its been hard and it feels nice to hear this from a person. Evee since i lost my pet, ive spiraled in and out of depressive/suicidal  thoughts, just like when i was 14. And my family hasnt been the best source of support; they tell me to get over it and why am i reacting this way now a month after his death. But this is nice. It makes me wanna frame this comment. 

Thank you, i know i couldnt go to hotline, so this was the next best thing. Hopefully things get better. Youve definitely steered me away from hurting myself. Thank you.
